text: A stone is thrown with speed 15 m s horizontally from the top of a vertical cliff 20 m above the sea.
The ends of a light elastic string of natural length 0.8 m and modulus of elasticity λ N are attached
to fixed points A and B which are 1.2 m apart at the same horizontal level. A particle of mass 0.3 kg
is attached to the centre of the string, and released from rest at the mid-point of AB. The particle
descends 0.32 m vertically before coming to instantaneous rest.
